head: iOS 27 Notification Center swipe changed: it now opens from the top-left
dek: On iPhones and iPads with Siri AI turned on, a swipe down from the middle of the top edge now opens Siri, and Notification Center opens from the top-left corner instead. Without Siri AI, the swipe works as before.
details: Notification Center has opened with a swipe down from the top since iOS 5 in 2011. On iPad, the top edge is now split: Notification Center on the left, Control Center on the right and Siri in the middle. 9to5Mac found no setting that gives the middle swipe back to Notification Center.
where: iPhone with iOS 27 and iPad with iPadOS 27, once Siri AI is on
means: If your notifications seem to be gone after turning on Siri AI, they're still there: they just moved to the top-left corner.
todo: Swipe down from the top-left corner of the screen to see your notifications; there's no switch to change the middle swipe back.
